Module io.github.jpersist.tools.api

module io.github.jpersist.tools.api
Core API module for the Persistence Tools Libraries.

Defines the Service Provider Interfaces (SPIs) for build-time validation and bytecode enhancement of JPA persistence artifacts. This module contains no concrete implementations; provider modules such as io.github.jpersist.tools.jakarta and io.github.jpersist.tools.legacy are discovered at runtime through the ServiceLoader mechanism.

Exported packages

  • persist.api.spi — root service-provider interface (PersistenceServiceProvider)
  • persist.lint.api — shared model types (NamedObjectDescriptor, NamedObjectType)
  • persist.lint.api.spi — linting SPIs (NamedObjectParser, SchemaValidator, and their factories)
  • persist.hibernate.enhance.spi — Hibernate bytecode enhancement SPI (HibernateEnhancer, HibernateEnhancerProvider)

Service declarations

This module declares uses directives for all provider interfaces so that ServiceLoader can locate implementations at runtime.

Since:
3.1.0
